scope: Independent static audit of newly added commit/push helper; earlier isolated-helper scope retained.

findings.title: Commit admission does not bind required gate commands and checkout
findings.description: The commit arm accepts final-gates using completed/exit/base/input flag/log hash but does not require worktree=W or the exact successful four-command sequence. It accepts canonical-review receipt using only exit/base/log hash, without completion, worktree or actual required review-check command. A log-integrity-valid success receipt for the same base but another checkout, or one omitting/replacing a required command, can therefore be admitted before git add/commit.
acceptance: Require exact worktree/base and terminal completion evidence for both receipts; require the final four-command sequence and successful finished rows.
Require canonical review-check command, --require-reviews and trusted --base at the intended worktree with actual completed result.
Bind coverage root/counts and reject negative fixture variants (wrong worktree, absent/duplicate/replaced command, failed/incomplete check) before mutation.
Preserve this helper/finding and save successor verification before any commit or push.

observations: Current observed final batch receipt is correct. This is a concrete guard behavior gap, not a claim that a wrong receipt was supplied.
No publication mutation or clone was executed by this auditor.
Parent reports three spacing-only report transforms; current hashes are bound here. No scientific/dossier input changed.
